name: ShippingGuard – Advanced Shipping Protection
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
ShippingGuard is a professional-grade shipping protection plugin for WooCommerce. It empowers store owners to offer an optionalized “Delivery Guarantee” or “Shipping Protection” fee at checkout, giving customers peace of mind and protecting your bottom line from shipping mishaps.

With an integrated claims management portal and real-time analytics, ShippingGuard is the complete solution for modern e-commerce stores looking to professionalize their shipping post-purchase experience.

Key Features:
* Dynamic Pricing Engine: Set fees as Fixed amounts, Percentages of the cart total (with optional caps), or Tiered structures.
* Smart Rules: Automatically show/hide protection based on minimum order amounts.
* Flexible Exclusions: Skip protection for digital products, virtual items, or specific categories/products.
* Integrated Claims Management: A dedicated portal in “My Account” where customers can file claims, upload proof of damage, and track status.
* Real-time Analytics: Track your opt-in rates, total revenue generated, and claim statistics from a clean, modern dashboard.
* High-Performance Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the new WooCommerce Blocks checkout.
* Modern Admin UI: Built with a sleek React-based interface for a seamless management experience.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shippingguard directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ShippingGuard -> Settings to configure your pricing and rules.
sections.faq:
How do I set the protection fee?

Navigate to ShippingGuard > Settings. You can choose from Fixed, Percentage, or Tiered pricing models.

Can I exclude specific products?

Yes, you can exclude specific products or entire categories from the protection offer in the settings panel.

Does it work with the new WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes, ShippingGuard is fully compatible with both the classic checkout and the modern WooCommerce Blocks Cart/Checkout.
